An instance on which \emph{either} sampler emitted nothing has no finite ratio, so it is excluded from the geomean and counted in its own column: \emph{C$=$0} (CMSGen silent --- an outright win for us, which makes the geomeans conservative), \emph{G$=$0} (GPAP silent --- an outright loss), \emph{both} (neither sampler reached the instance). Every instance is counted exactly once: $\emph{inst} = n + \text{C}{=}0 + \text{G}{=}0 + \text{both} + \text{free} + \text{vacuous}$, and the win count is taken over the same rows as the geomean plus the two zero columns.
